messages:
Kira (docs): Starting a quick thread for the changelog + relnotes sweep. Need: one-liner public blurb, migration snippet for SDK param rename, and a short "docs fixes" checklist (link rot + anchor remaps). Anyone hit blockers? :mag:

Ben (eng): Repro'd a small perf regression in reranker endpoints under burst load. Not widespread but worth a known-issue bullet and a mitigation: lower batch size or pin older model variant until patch. I'll paste the runtime issue link.

Leo (sdk): I'll update snippets. Param rename: `response_length` -> `max_output_tokens`. We'll accept the old name for one release and emit a single warning. Tiny migration snippet below.

Asha (product): Public blurb should stay customer-friendly: "Improved model routing for lower average cost; small-scale reranker bursts may need tuning." Keep it short.

Kira (docs): Using that sentence. Leo, paste the one-line sed snippet so I can drop it into relnotes.

Leo (sdk): Here you go:

```bash
# replace param across repo
grep -R "response_length" -n | cut -d: -f1 | xargs sed -i 's/response_length/max_output_tokens/g'
```

Ben (eng): Runtime link: https://ci.internal/runtime/changes/2026-04-01 (contains repro + suggested batch-size mitigation).

Kira (docs): For docs fixes: 1) anchor remap for embeddings guide, 2) two stale external links in quickstarts, 3) example that used positional constructor (needs replacing). Can owners paste exact mappings/snippets here?

Leo (sdk): Constructor migrate one-liner for JS:

```js
// old
const c = new RedwoodClient('KEY', 'gpt-x')
// new
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: 'KEY', model: 'gpt-x' })
```

Ben (eng): Anchor remap example: `/docs/guides/embeddings#batch` -> `/docs/guides/embeddings#batching-usage`. I'll push the full map to the docs PR.

InfraBot: staging docs build queued for branch `release/docs-219999`  logs: https://ci.internal/builds/219999

Kira (docs): Action items: Leo -> PR with snippets + compat warning, Ben -> runtime link + full anchor map, Asha -> approve public blurb. I'll assemble and post draft tomorrow AM for 1-2 line edits.

Asha (product): Approved. Keep public blurb one line.

Kira (docs): Thanks all :sparkles:
